{{Quote|His nickname's Chance. He's my lucky star.|Lando Calrissian, introducing his son, Lando Jr|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>}}
'''Lando Calrissian Junior''', nicknamed '''Chance''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] around [[41 ABY]] to [[Tendra Risant Calrissian]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian, Senior]]. The curly-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] was nicknamed Chance and was adored by his [[Parent/Legends|father]], who, along with his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], brought up their son in a life of affluence. The Calrissians owned eight homes, and Calrissian Junior was with them on [[Lujo]] when their friends the [[Solo family/Legends|Solos]] visited them in [[43 ABY]]. He was also with them on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] later in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] when [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] were threatening a [[Calrissian-Nunb Mines|mining operation]] they owned, and the entire family attended the [[wedding of Jagged Fel and Jaina Solo]] [[44 ABY|one year later]].

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Calrissian|Amelia, do you remember little Lando?|Solo|Hi, Lando. Is that the dragon from Castle Creep?|Calrissian Junior|Perystal.|Solo|I watch that show, too! Is Perystal your favorite toy?|Calrissian Junior|I have a [[Prince Gothik]].|Solo|Wow. I used to have a stuffed tauntaun.|attr=Lando Calrissian introduces Allana Solo to his son, Lando Junior|src=<ref name="Millennium Falcon chapter" />)}}
[[File:JustLando-AlliesBackCover.jpg|thumb|200px|The boy's father: Lando Calrissian Senior]]
Lando Calrissian, Junior was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], the [[Youngling/Legends|son]] of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian, Senior]] and [[Tendra Risant Calrissian]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon chapter" /> Calrissian Senior first learned of his [[Marriage/Legends|wife's]] [[Reproduction/Legends|pregnancy]] while on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury" /> late in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].<ref name="Reader's Companion, Fury" /> Already over seventy [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old,<ref name="Leland's Blog: Major Character Birth Years">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}} pegs [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Senior's]] [[Standard year/Legends|birth year]] at [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], while ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' {{C|under "Fury"}} sets the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]'' at [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].</ref> he was shaken by the news, believing simultaneously that he was both too old and not yet ready to be a [[Parent/Legends|father]]. His friends [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] reassured him, however, pointing out that the wealthy couple would spoil their child and would be the parents that everyone dreamed of having. Feeling better about the situation, Calrissian told his friends he would likely [[Holocomm/Legends|comm]] them for parenting advice, and he left Kashyyyk to be with his wife.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury" />

In [[43 ABY]],<ref name="Reader's Companion, Millennium Falcon">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' {{C|under "Millennium Falcon"}}</ref> Lando Calrissian Junior was a curly-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] infant who greatly resembled his father. Nicknamed Chance, he was adored by Calrissian Senior, who called his son his lucky star. The Calrissian family owned eight homes, including one on [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], and when the [[Solo family/Legends|Solos]] visited them at their [[Ocean/Legends|seaside]] residence on [[Lujo]], Calrissian Junior was greeted by their granddaughter [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]]. He shyly showed her his [[Perystal]] doll, a [[dragon]] from the [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] program ''[[Castle Creep]]'', before retreating to the comfort of his father. The entire group then went sailing on the Calrissians' catamaran ''[[Windchaser]]''.<ref name="Millennium Falcon chapter" />

Later in the year,<ref name="Reader's Companion, Outcast">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' {{C|under "Outcast"}}</ref> Calrissian Senior invited the Solos to [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] to help him investigate [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] that were threatening his [[Calrissian-Nunb Mines|mining operation]] on the rocky world. After their arrival, Calrissian Junior played with Allana under the watchful eye of his [[Nanny droid/Legends|nanny droid]], [[Nanna]], as well as the Solos' [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], in a chamber adjacent to the conference room where the adults sat and discussed their problem. Nanna later put him down for a nap, and when he woke up, he joined Allana in the cafeteria, where he was confused that the Solos had not yet returned. They had in fact been trapped in the [[Mining/Legends|mines]] behind walls of rock, but the senior Calrissians were later able to locate them while their son ate breakfast with Allana.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast" />

With the help of some old friends, the Calrissians and Solos sucessfully [[Mission to save Kessel|stabilized]] the [[Great Kessel Fault]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast" /> The entire Calrissian family attended the [[Wedding of Jagged Fel and Jaina Solo|wedding]] of the Solos' daughter [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] to [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]<ref name="Apocalypse chapter">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> [[44 ABY|one year later]]<ref name="Reader's Companion, Apocalypse">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' {{C|under "Apocalypse"}}</ref> aboard the [[Hapan Battle Dragon]] ''[[Dragon Queen II]]''.<ref name="Apocalypse chapter" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Where's uncle Han?''"<br />"''Not back yet. They're not dead, you know. I'd have felt it.''"<br />"''Where's Aunt Leia?''"<br />"''Not back yet.|Chance questions Allana Solo|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>}}
As an infant, Lando Calrissian Junior had curly hair and looked to be all but a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of his father, who was very fond of his son and brought him up in wealth and luxury.<ref name="Millennium Falcon chapter" /> When the criminal [[Craitheus Qreph]] offered to purchase one of Calrissian Senior's [[Sarnus Refinery|asteroid refineries]] and made what Calrissian perceived to be a veiled threat to his wife and son's safety, the famous [[Gambling/Legends|gambler's]] face outwardly displayed fear.<ref name="Crucible chapter">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>

Nicknamed Chance, the young Calrissian watched the holovid program ''Castle Creep'' and played with dolls from the show, his favorite character being [[Prince Gothik]]. He enjoyed showing them off but was too shy to speak more than a handful of sentences about them to Allana Solo, preferring the safety of his father's [[Limb/Legends|legs]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon chapter" /> He was more comfortable with her a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, bombarding her with questions about her grandparents&mdash;whom he thought of as Aunt Leia and Uncle Han&mdash;while he rhythmically kicked the underside of a table. When he ate breakfast with Allana, Calrissian Junior played with his [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|A happier development in ''Fury'' is Lando Calrissian learning that his wife, Tendra, is pregnant. Their son would feature as a character in ''Millennium Falcon'' (2008) and ''Outcast'' (2009).|''The Essential Reader's Companion''{{'s}} entry on ''Fury''|<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>}}
Lando Calrissian first discovers his wife's pregnancy in the [[2007]] novel [[Legacy of the Force: Fury|''Fury'']], written by [[Aaron Allston]].<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury" /> ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the book to the very end of 40 ABY,<ref name="Reader's Companion, Fury" /> but when Calrissian Junior first appears in [[James Luceno]]'s [[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']] novel,<ref name="Millennium Falcon chapter" /> set in early-to-mid 43 ABY,<ref name="Reader's Companion, Millennium Falcon" /> he is said to already be three years old.<ref name="Millennium Falcon chapter" />
